notes: Variant WLC.JOB.33.19.v001 was selected to r01, covering s008 and s009; the marginal 'While all his bones are firm' is not the projection.

The supplied 'with' before rîḇ is attached to that nominal under rule 33. The competing reading distributes the earlier bə across both phrases under rule 25; I rejected it because in the selected reading rîḇ heads its own clause rather than standing coordinated under the first preposition's scope.
The waw takes the postpositive 'also' under rule 51; the distance from the waw is not evidence against it.
